narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The blanks add to ten, so each blank is five.
<bookmark mark='test'/>Test it, and the third row becomes nine, eleven, eleven. The second row is then twenty and twenty two.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The top would be forty two, not fifty, so the blanks are not equal.

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Name the blanks with letters, and each known box gives you one fact about them.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. The top is seventeen, and the second row is a blank, then eight.
<bookmark mark='foot'/>The bottom row is one, a blank, two, a blank, so fill every box.
